load_personas: load persona instances and agent data for a signaling marketplace simulation with configurable number of agents
generate_cash_values: generate cash values for agents using pareto or mixed wealth distribution types
generate_mixed_sex_dates: generate mixed-sex date pairings for each day ensuring no repeated pairings across days
generate_same_sex_convos: generate same-sex conversation pairings for each day with leftover handling for odd group sizes
generate_disjoint_dyads: generate random disjoint pairs from a list of names with optional leftover handling
